title: Impact of COVID-19 Work Arrangements on Sectoral Productivity Rates
what_it_is: Impact of COVID-19 Work Arrangements on Sectoral Productivity Rates

sections.label: 2020 sector labour productivity changes
sections.summary: In 2020, productivity rose in manufacturing, wholesale trade and finance and insurance, but fell in transportation and storage and F&B services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In 2020, labour productivity, as measured by real value-added per actual hour worked, or AHW, rose for outward-oriented sectors such as manufacturing, wholesale trade, and finance and insurance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For example, the productivity of the manufacturing and wholesale trade sectors increased by 18.6% and 3.1%, respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In particular, the productivity of the transportation and storage and F&B services sectors fell by 22.1% and 17.7%, respectively.

sections.label: Hybrid work productivity measure
sections.summary: Real value-added per actual hour worked better measures labour productivity in hybrid work by accounting for varying labour input intensity.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In the context of a hybrid model of working, real value-added per actual hour worked also provides a more accurate measure of labour productivity, as it accounts for the varying intensity of labour input by employees under different types of work arrangements.

sections.label: ILO recognises AHW measure
sections.summary: Real VA per AHW is internationally recognised, including by ILO, as a better productivity measure because actual hours capture labour input intensity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Of the two measures that we talked about, real VA per AHW is recognised internationally including, as I mentioned earlier, by ILO, to be a better measure of labour productivity, because the actual hours will capture the intensity of labour input more accurately.

sections.label: Domestically oriented sectors contraction
sections.summary: Domestically oriented sectors had a 15.9% value-add contraction in 2020, versus 0.9% for outward-oriented sectors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The domestically oriented sectors experienced a steeper contraction in value-add in 2020, a reduction in 15.9% as compared to the outward oriented sector's decrease in 0.9%.

sections.label: ITM refresh and upskilling
sections.summary: The 23 refreshed ITMs seek productivity gains through technology, upskilling and good job and skills matching.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Our refresh of the Industry Transformation Maps (ITMs), the 23 ITMs that Minister of State Low had mentioned earlier on, seek to find ways to increase productivity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The increase in technological advances and progress in the way in which we work and how we work, will help in no small measure to help us to increase productivity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: But the key part of this is we need to make sure that we upskill, which is a key factor in our ITM and we make sure that there is a good job and skills match such that our people can take on better jobs, increase their productivity and make use of the technological advances available so that as a whole, across multi-sector, productivity advances can be seen over time.
